settings.title: CarPlay Ultra
settings.description: Master switch for experimental Ultra features. Standard K5 integration remains available when off.

settings.title: CarPlayStartSession
settings.description: Requests Ultra startup negotiation through Wireless CarPlay. Requires Theme Identity.

settings.title: Theme Identity
settings.description: Advertises the Apple theme identifier and asset version to the phone.

settings.title: Virtual Cluster
settings.description: Advertises a secondary virtual display. Does not replace the physical instrument cluster.

settings.title: Themed Display IDs
settings.description: Uses the Apple theme's display identifiers. Requires Virtual Cluster.

settings.title: DBX Vehicle Variant
settings.description: Requests Aston Martin DBX styling in supported vehicle interfaces.

settings.title: UI Synchronization
settings.description: Enables theme layout and palette communication. Currently causes connection failures on the K5.

settings.title: Extended Features
settings.description: Advertises additional non-audio LIVI capabilities; may unlock additional interfaces.

settings.title: Original Feature Mask
settings.description: Uses the broader LIVI capability mask, including audio-related bits. Requires Extended Features.

settings.title: Enhanced RequestCarUI
settings.description: Advertises enhanced vehicle-interface support to the phone.

settings.title: K5 Vehicle Integration
settings.description: Enables climate, seats, vehicle information, radio, Comfort and CarPlay volume/media popup replacement. Keeps native popups outside CarPlay.

settings.title: Parked AirPlay Video & Audio
settings.description: Experimental video with sound while safely parked. Stops when Park confirmation is lost.

settings.title: SiriusXM Discovery
settings.description: Advertises a disabled experimental satellite radio source. Does not enable tuning.

settings.title: LIVI Display Extras
settings.description: Advertises additional display metadata used by LIVI. May affect available CarPlay interfaces.

settings.title: Receiver Version Override
settings.description: Reports receiver version 950.7.1 instead of the stock version. May affect feature negotiation.
